Overview

Pets are a late-game unlockable in War Of Genesis, helpful for providing a range of stat boosts to your profile! In this guide we'll explain how to unlock Pets, and showcase the stats of each one so you have a better idea of which are the best ones to go after!




How To Unlock Pets

In order to unlock each Pet, you'll need to unlock the Arena. This is a PvP mode in which you'll duel other players of a similar or higher overall character Rank for exclusive reward. The higher the rank placement you get in the Arena, the higher ammount of Ether you'll get, which can then be spent on Growth Pet Eggs in the Ether Shop.




Here's some of the abilities you can expect from the various pets in the game.

Lower Grades: Basic Stat Boosts
Higher Grades: In-Depth Abilities

It must be noted that at the time of making this guide, pets can not be obtained via purchase on the Steam Market, for what would typically be a quick way of shortcutting their somewhat elusive drop chances in the game.

Tips & Tricks
Make sure to train skills such as Combat Defense and Duel before heading into PvP arenas for an easier time farming ranks.


If the lineup of opponents in your list is too hard, don't waste your invitations, and instead wait for the list to refresh. You should only be taking on opponents you truly believe can be defeated.
